name: Disneyland The Tropical Hideaway Classic Dole Whip Pineapple Soft-Serve Cup
whyItWorks: 100% dairy-free, vegan pineapple soft-serve! Smooth, refreshing, and completely lactose-free. Pineapple contains natural bromelain and is far gentler than acidic citrus lemon soft-serve.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the classic pineapple Dole Whip in a cup (pass on spicy Tajín seasoning or chamoy).
